verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV docs mention that Identity Verification integrates with Monitor for watchlist/PEP screening (docs-10, docs-13), implying some continuous watchlist capability exists as part of the broader Plaid ecosystem, but the IDV-specific webhook events (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) are tied to a single verification session's completion, not ongoing re-screening of previously verified users against watchlist updates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of continuous/periodic re-screening cadence for already-verified users, and dedicated event types signaling watchlist status changes post-verification (as opposed to session-progress events).
